snippet.title: Steal & Sell Simulator - FREE DEMO AVAILABLE ON STEAM
snippet.description:
Check it out:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4754910/Steal__Sell_Simulator/

Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.
